headline: Weathered Expanse Leads as Nevish Line Falls Quiet
war_summary: Since the last edition the centre of action has shifted. The Weathered Expanse now leads the wire with four changes in two hours and twenty-five on the day about Frostmarch, Shattered Advance, Huntsfort and Wightwalk, holdings standing at two Warden to seven Colonial with day losses above eleven thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden. Callahan's Passage follows with two changes in two hours and twenty-five on the day about The Latch, holdings now nine Warden to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each add two changes in two hours, fourteen and thirteen on the day respectively, about Breaker Town and The Reach with split holdings. Linn Mercy and Palantine Berm show late movement at Lathair and Leiri Hermanni. The Nevish Line, Mooring County, Viper Pit and Fisherman's Row, busy a day ago, record no changes in the past two and six hours, with Nevish still counting twenty on the day about Princefal. Elsewhere the map is quiet, with most regions reporting no base changes in twenty-four hours despite continued casualties and enlistments.
